mapper.select: SELECT r.review_id, r.rating, r.content, r.created_at, u.nickname, CASE WHEN r.user_id = #{userId} THEN true ELSE false END AS isMine FROM book_reviews r JOIN users u ON u.user_id = r.user_id WHERE r.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.book_id = #{bookId} AND r.content IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(r.content) != '' ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM book_reviews r WHERE r.book_id = #{bookId} AND r.content IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(r.content) != '' AND r.status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT r.rating, count(*) AS count FROM book_reviews r WHERE r.book_id = #{bookId} AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY r.rating
